affected_surfaces.native_certificate_meaning: The old q1 gate omitted the original-fit residual term. Signed residual compensation changes only the identity certificate, retains raw public discrepancy, point/influence/remainder values and solver/arithmetic tolerances, and adds no solve/RNG/dynamic allocation. It permits correctly computed calls previously rejected by the incomplete certificate. Earlier native q1 passes do not by themselves qualify this changed behavior.

integrated_development.recorded_scope: staged development; new native plugin exercised separately and by later clean qualification
integrated_development.allowed_claim: The integrated checker completed successfully on a staged development tree based on 7fb65c41.
integrated_development.prohibited_claim: The complete integrated checker ran on clean 63757839 or b9f80ce9, or that every phase ran on the later file hash snapshot.
integrated_development.limitation: The run receipt records a base HEAD and staged-development scope, not a complete immutable run-start source or binary hash manifest. The separate changed-file snapshot does not establish that exact snapshot was used throughout the integrated run. Matching later file hashes cannot retrospectively supply that missing link.

exact_focused_development.allowed_claim: Source-hashed exact runtime and independent exact oracle bytes are unchanged at 637 and b9; focused exact/projection/inference checks remain relevant within their declared development scope.
exact_focused_development.limitation: Only the two listed source files were hashed by this focused receipt; it is not a complete installed-package or native qualification manifest.

q1_certificate_focused.allowed_claim: Independent imperfect-solve/fault tests, frozen failed-draw retest, paired core/FFI tests and eight-cell Stata tests exercise the repaired certificate; the recorded four source hashes equal committed 637.
q1_certificate_focused.limitation: Compiled after the functional certificate fix; subsequent changes were formatting, comments, and unit-test registration. Clean exact-source rebuild is required for qualification.

clean_rust_source_gates.allowed_claim: Fresh pinned formatting, strict Clippy, workspace all-target tests and backend all-target tests pass at 637; these cover the committed Rust certificate and its registered tests.
clean_rust_source_gates.limitation: These commands do not establish Stata runtime, licensed Windows execution, full Python harness validation, statistical coverage or complete native distribution qualification.

final_harness_bytes_development_smoke.allowed_claim: Final 637 harness/registration bytes complete a two-task development numerical smoke with per-task output/receipt validation.
final_harness_bytes_development_smoke.limitation: The smoke used an earlier development production/plugin before the certificate repair. It binds final harness bytes, not 637 native runtime or complete sampling coverage. Earlier 12-cell smoke-v4 used an older run.py and remains older transport-development evidence.

final_harness_unit_tests.untracked_scope: windows-input-identity.json was outside the affected source and was not opened, hashed, copied or treated as test input. Status records filenames only.
final_harness_unit_tests.allowed_claim: All 32 final focused harness tests pass against byte-verified b9f80ce9 source; each recorded harness/registration file also exactly matches 63757839.
final_harness_unit_tests.limitation: This replaces the prior unsaved focused-test report with an explicit source/runtime/log receipt. It does not retroactively bind the earlier integrated checker or establish sampling or platform qualification.

windows_only_implementation_to_checkpoin.review: Read-only review checked Start-Process process-level stdout/stderr redirection, waiting, zero/nonzero native ExitCode propagation, process disposal, and preservation of the explicitly quoted cmd payload. The added regression checks exact stdout/stderr on exit 0 and exact native exit 17 failure. No estimator/scientific behavior, ABI, solver/RNG tolerance or route changes occur in this four-file commit.
